intro: Gain the skills to heal others through our 7-day Ayurvedic Massage Course in Uluwatu Bali, Indonesia. Our comprehensive program will equip you with a deep understanding of Ayurveda’s origins, fundamental principles, and hands-on practices in various types of Ayurvedic massages from the head to the toes such as full-body massages, head massage, face massage, as well as target-specific massage techniques.

keyFacts.label: Certification
keyFacts.value: Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society (as stated)

curriculum.title: Day 1
items: Why to learn Ayurveda? And Its Benefits
Importance of Ayurveda in Daily Life
Knowledge of the common Ayurveda oils
Introduction of traditional Ayurvedic Massage (Abhyanga): what is Abhyanga; importance & benefits; procedure; do’s and don’ts; pre & post requirements; contraindications
Full Body Massage along with practical demonstration

curriculum.title: Day 2
items: Introduction to Tridosha & Prakriti (Know Your Body Type)

curriculum.title: Day 3
items: Practical of Neck and Shoulder Massage

schedule.heading: We offer the course throughout the year of 2025.
schedule.note: Please contact us to check availabilities of your desired dates.

extras.label: Booking deposit

inclusions: Course is certified by Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society.
Yoga mats and materials for all activities are available at the school (to be used in the classes only, not to be taken away)
Free high-speed WiFi throughout the school campus
arrival: Check in – 12pm (on the first day of the course)
Check out – 12pm (on the last day of the course)

policies.title: Note
items: Do not eat heavy foods before the session.
Certification upon the successful completion of the course.

policies.title: Booking
items: In order to book for the course, deposit the booking course fees of 200 USD. The balance amount must be paid on arrival at school. An official confirmation letter of your program will be sent to you shortly after successful booking deposit for the course fees.

policies.title: Schedule changes
items: Management team is authorised to make the necessary changes in the daily schedule if needed.

policies.title: Important Info
items: Advance course registration is required to reserve your seat.
We take a limited number of students in Ayurveda training programs so advance registration is required.
After successful completion, certificates are issued by Himalayan Yoga Association Society.

Participants are required to attend all the sessions. Meat, fish, eggs, alcohol, tobacco, drugs and nudity are prohibited during the course as they are counterproductive to the practices. Participants who do not comply with the school rules will be dismissed from the course.
Always be disciplined, respect teachers and follow all rules. Always be on time; if you are late you will not be permitted to join class.
Bali Yoga School provides accommodation for a student who joins the course. Friends or relatives are not included in accommodation; however, they can stay in school by renting another room.
All classes are mandatory; only in case of an emergency or illness can one take leave, with the teacher's permission. Uninformed leaves won’t be accepted.
